Matías Sauter-Morera is a contemporary artist known ⁤for his ‌innovative ‌use of photography and artificial intelligence (AI) to explore themes of ‌identity, reality, and‌ narrative.Born⁤ in 1986 ‍in San josé, ⁣Costa⁣ Rica, Sauter-Morera completed his studies in photography and taught at the Veritas University in⁣ San José before assisting in a landscape photography project for the Musée du quai Branly in Argentina [2[2[2[2 ].
Sauter-Morera’s work ‍often delves into provocative and homoerotic imagery,using AI to generate visuals that⁣ challenge conventional norms and create new⁢ realities‍ [2[2[2[2 ]. One of his notable projects​ is “Pegamachos,” which employs AI to create a virtual narrative, showcasing his interest in blending technology wiht artistic expression [1[1[1[1 ].
His artistic practice involves moving between ⁤physical and ⁣social worlds, ⁣using ​photography to confront and create new realities. An​ example ‌of his work is “Dark taninos Tortuguero Jungle” from the series “New World⁢ Tropics,” a⁤ 2024 piece that exemplifies⁤ his exploration of identity⁢ and reality ⁤ [3[3[3[3 ].
Sauter-Morera’s work is⁣ characterized⁤ by it’s innovative use of ⁤technology and⁣ its exploration of complex themes related to ‌identity and reality.
Recreating the Life of ⁤Pegamachos In the heart ‌of Costa Rica, a unique subculture known as the pegamachos thrives, living an⁤ undercover lifestyle of hidden romance. For these individuals, anonymity is not just a preference but a‍ necessity for their safety. This concern for protection ‍lead artist Matías Sauter ‌Morera to use artificial intelligence ⁣(AI) to create his striking work.
Morera’s latest piece, “Pozitas” ,is a ‌fine art c-print that captures the essence of the pegamachos’ world. The artwork depicts two men partially submerged ⁢in a lush, forested water setting. Both have wet skin, and one is wearing a gold necklace. The background is⁤ dense with trees and greenery, creating a serene, natural ambiance. This ⁢piece is part of an edition of five, each ​measuring 20 x 20 ‍inches.
Morera’s‌ choice to use AI was driven by a⁣ desire to protect the identities of real‌ peopel. He explained, “AI provided a way also to achieve‍ this without intruding on real lives or placing real Costa Rican faces that people of the community might recognize.”
The use of AI ⁢in art has been a growing trend, with notable institutions like the Getty Museum acquiring AI-generated pieces. This technology allows artists to explore new ⁢dimensions of creativity while addressing ethical concerns related to privacy and identity.

photographic Mimicry: Matías Sauter ‌Morera’s AI-Enhanced Art In the‍ ever-evolving world of art,⁣ Matías Sauter Morera has emerged as a visionary, blending the realms of artificial intelligence and conventional photography to create a unique visual‌ narrative. His latest series, “Pink⁤ Cadillac,” is a striking example of how ​technology can be harnessed to imagine and construct parallel histories.
The Art of AI Mimicry Morera’s⁣ work is a fascinating exploration of photographic mimicry.By⁢ combining multiple AI models with Photoshop,⁢ he envisions AI-generated⁣ subjects in ​realistic scenarios.This approach allows him to create ⁣a parallel history that is free from censorship and risk to individuals’ ‍lives.Each image is a result of⁣ hundreds of commands⁤ and months of meticulous work,reflecting Morera’s dedication to perfection.
A Hidden Culture revealed Morera told⁤ artnet , “Since the pegamachos culture remains​ hidden, these AI images serve as a mimicry of photography,‌ a fiction, and a medium through which I can imagine⁢ and construct an imagined parallel history.” This statement underscores the ‌artist’s intent to⁤ use AI as a tool ​for storytelling ⁢and cultural exploration.
The Exhibition and Recognition Morera’s work was first introduced to the Los Angeles art ⁢scene through an exhibition at the craig Kroll Gallery. The exhibition showcased his innovative‌ approach to art, which caught the attention of the Getty Museum. The museum promptly recognized the breakthrough innovation and cultural significance of Morera’s work.
Visualizing the Imagination One of the standout pieces from Morera’s ⁢series is‍ “Pink Cadillac,” a captivating image of a man in a pink cowboy hat and shiny pink outfit leaning against a pink car.The confident pose and ⁣the crowd of ​people in various hats in⁢ the background create ⁤a vivid and dynamic scene. This image, along with others in the series,​ demonstrates Morera’s ability to blend the real and the imagined, creating a visual⁢ narrative that is both engaging and thought-provoking.
The Impact of AI in Art Morera’s use of AI in his‌ art is a ⁤testament to the growing influence ‌of technology in the creative industry. As AI ⁤continues to evolve, artists like Morera are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, creating new ways to express ⁣ideas and tell stories. His work serves as⁣ an ‍inspiration for other artists to explore the potential of AI⁣ in their own creative processes.
